integration_decision.name: CAUSAL_STALE_PAYLOAD_ORACLE_FOR_EXISTING_TWO_BOUNDARY_CONTRACT
integration_decision.new_distinction: Per-path B snapshot hash mismatch alone does not causally identify stale A output. Pin A's pre-publication stale payload and require final output to match A's payload while B publication was positively witnessed. This prevents mislabeling unrelated per-path changes as stale-generation overwrite; no production defect claimed.
runnable_no_network_contract: Use exact-SHA checkout; fresh tmp dir per scenario; T=1700000000000; network=False; spawn top-level child targets. Child A patches runner.atomic_write_json locally (not storage or parent) and pauses fail-closed at requested path after building payload.

At A_PAUSED record the exact paused A path and serialized payload SHA-256; assert child A's loaded archive was empty by instrumentation/returned result and its precomputed anata handoff lacks provenance_refs entry farside_etf:rowB. A must not be released on missing witnesses.

APPENDER append exactly one PIT-visible rowB to observations.jsonl, verify append count and durable archive read. Spawn unpatched B. Require B exitcode=0, archive_records_loaded=1, source_evidence rowB and provenance_refs farside_etf:rowB, persisted anata_latest.json rowB; capture independent SHA-256 plus parsed identity for each B-published latest.json/audit_latest.json/anata_latest.json.

Scenario L: pause A before anata_latest.json, after its latest/audit writes. After B_PUBLISHED and snapshots, release A; final anata_latest.json matching A's pre-pause payload with rowB absent while other paths retain B snapshots is RED mixed-generation stale publication. Hash changes without A-payload identity => INCONCLUSIVE.

Scenario F: fresh tmp dir; pause A before latest.json, then B publishes all three. After A release, require final per-path content to equal A's own captured prepublication payloads (record all three A payloads inside child) and differ from each B snapshot; final handoff lacking rowB is RED whole-generation stale overwrite. A-only final hash mismatch is insufficient proof.

Each scenario: positive phase trace A_PAUSED/ROWB_APPENDED/B_PUBLISHED/A_RELEASED, bounded Queue waits/process joins/terminate+join, exitcodes and exception messages, fail-closed timeouts; if B cannot publish before A release, record serialization evidence or INCONCLUSIVE, never PASS by timeout.

After any RED/INCONCLUSIVE, spawn recovery C on same directory, require persisted handoff rowB restored and all three outputs parse; preserve test logs. Run targeted deterministic pytest then python -m pytest -q part2/capital_flow/tests. Do not edit production code or claim tests run before executing.
